Previous lessons:
Account safety and persistence hints on sign-in, along with path duration and persistence hints, consistently proved helpful, though several hints showed no clear effect.
Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection was helpful, whereas reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Personality-driven headlines and live generation countdown timers were helpful, but general copy overhauls, story copy, and time headlines either hurt or showed no clear effect.
Flow bypasses and tutorial screens had early wins but later hurt or showed no clear effect; sub-flows, trait selectors, and major redesigns consistently hurt or had no clear effect.
Notifications, chimes, layout modifications, badges/incentives, and wait-screen activity tips showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for major redesigns, sub-flows, copy changes, and post-photo sign-in reordering, while underestimating gains from targeted hints, headlines, and live timers.

lessons: Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection worked, whereas reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Targeted sign-in security and persistence hints, along with path duration and persistence hints, frequently worked, though several hints showed no clear effect or hurt.

Personality-driven headlines, headline refreshes, and live generation countdown timers worked, but general story copy, photo quality guidance, and time headlines either hurt or showed no clear effect.

Select layout redesigns and tutorial screens worked (such as the photo upload split layout and desktop tray guide screen), whereas sub-flows, trait selectors, and flow bypasses either hurt or showed no clear effect.
Notifications, audio chimes, wait-screen activity tips, badges, and incentives showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for sub-flows, story copy, and post-photo sign-in reordering, while underestimating gains for targeted headlines, live timers, and specific guide or layout updates.
